XGBoost ignition classifier, production fit 2020–2026 on California, Oregon and Washington samples. Train 2020–2021–2022–2023, threshold tuned on 2024, tested out of time on 2025: ROC-AUC 0.785, AUC-PR 0.0055.
Inputs ERA5-Land, SRTM, NASA SMAP, KBDI, MODIS NDVI · labels NASA FIRMS.
KBDI the KBDI source covers Asia-Pacific only, so California has no values and every cell, in training too, carries the 300 fallback. The model's KBDI importance comes from synthetic training rows, not drought.
Risk level share of cells at or above the threshold: Low < 0.1%, Moderate < 1%, Elevated < 5%, Severe ≥ 5%. These are display bands, not model outputs.
